item.title: 12. Day 10 - Puros to Ongongo
item.description: A longer day in the saddle (192kms), typically described as a slow, technical 4×4 day rather than a “road drive”.

item.title: 29. River sections & crossing mitigation
item.description: Because we’ll be travelling on two wheels with support vehicles, crossing and travelling in several rivers, having up-to-date information on river levels and flow / flood risk is very important.

item.title: 10. Day 8 - van Zyl's camp to Marble Camp
item.description: A relative short distance (63kms) but an action packed day with striking scenery over the Marienfluss grasslands and rugged mountains that make it a bucket-list experience for serious adventurers.

item.title: 20. Lone men of Namibia
item.description: There are super cool stone sculptures placed around the region. These creative works-of-art are perfect for the terrain.

item.title: 9. Day 7 - Epupa Falls to van Zyl's camp
item.description: This where the exploration really gets interesting - where the feeling of the wilderness takes root, from a landscape, remoteness and riding perspective.

item.title: 8. Day 6 - Opuwo to Epupa Falls
item.description: Heading to some great river frontage on the Kunene river - separating Angola and Namibia.

item.title: 6. Day 4 - Palmwag to Khowarib
item.description: 126kms of really diverse and exciting riding - everything from hilly, rocky to hardpack, sandy and even fesh-fesh.
